{{Sexagenary cycle}}
'''Yin Wood Ox''' (乙丑, ''kinoto ushi''; onyomi ''otsuchū'') is the 2nd of the sixty combinations of the {{ill|Sexagenary cycle|af|Sestigdelige siklus|ar|دورة ستينية|arz|دوره ستينيه|as|ষাঠি বছৰীয়া আৱৰ্তন|ast|Ciclu sexaxenariu|bn|ষাটবার্ষিক চক্র|ca|Cicle sexagesimal|cdo|Găng-ciĕ|cs|Kan-č’|de|60-Jahre-Zyklus|eo|Ĉina sesdekjara ciklo|es|Ciclo sexagesimal chino|eu|Hirurogeitaka urteko ziklo|fa|چرخه شصت‌تایی|fr|Cycle sexagésimal chinois|hak|Kôn-chṳ̂|hy|Վաթսունամյա շրջան|id|Ganzhi|it|Ganzhi|ja|干支|ka|სამოცეული ციკლი|ko|간지|mk|Шеесетгодишен циклус|ms|Ganzhi|nn|Sekstiårig syklus|no|Sekstiårig syklus|ru|Система гань-чжи|sh|Seksagenarni ciklus|simple|Sexagenary cycle|su|Daur séksagenari|sv|Himmelska stammar och jordiska grenar|th|แผนภูมิสวรรค์|tr|Altmışlık döngü|uk|Шістдесятирічний цикл|vi|Can Chi|wuu|干支|xmf|გან-ჩჟიშ სისტემა|za|Gancei|zh|干支|zh_classical|干支|zh_min_nan|Kan-chi|zh_yue|干支|qid=Q246658|lt=Sexagenary cycle}}.

It is the 2nd of the sixty stem-branch combinations, preceded by {{ill|Yang Wood Rat|ja|甲子}} and followed by {{ill|Yang Fire Tiger|ja|丙寅}}. The {{ill|Heavenly Stems|af|Hemelstam|ca|Troncs celestes|cdo|Tiĕng-găng|de|Himmelsstämme|es|Troncos celestiales|fa|شاخه‌های آسمانی|fi|Taivaalliset rungot|fr|Tige céleste|gan|天干|hak|Thiên-kôn|id|Batang Langit|it|Tronco celeste|ja|十干|ko|천간|mk|Небесни стебла|ms|Tiangan|nl|Hemelse Stammen|pl|Niebiańskie pnie|ru|Небесные стволы|tr|Göksel Gövdeler|uk|Небесні стовбури|za|Diengan|zh|天干|zh_min_nan|Thian-kan|zh_yue|天干|qid=Q1190985|lt=Heavenly Stem}} ''乙'' is Yin Wood, and the {{ill|Earthly Branches|af|Aardtak|als|Erdzweige|az|Türk-monqol təqvimi|ca|Branques terrestres|cdo|Dê-ciĕ|de|Erdzweige|fa|شاخه‌های زمینی|fi|Maalliset oksat|fr|Branche terrestre|gan|地支|hak|Thi-chṳ̂|id|Cabang Bumi|it|Ramo terrestre|ja|十二支|ko|지지 (역법)|mk|Земски гранки|ms|Dizhi|pl|Ziemskie gałęzie|ru|Земные ветви|tr|12 hayvanlı takvim|ug|12 مۆچەل تەقۋىمى|uk|Земні гілки|za|Deihcei|zh|地支|zh_min_nan|Tē-chi|zh_yue|地支|qid=Q1072961|lt=Earthly Branch}} ''丑'' (Ox) is Yin Earth; together they form a Mutual Destruction relationship in {{ill|Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|af|Wu Xing|ar|نظرية العناصر الخمسة|bcl|Wu Xing|ca|Cinc processos (Wuxing)|cdo|Ngū-hèng|cs|Pět prvků|da|De fem faser|de|Fünf-Elemente-Lehre|el|Ου Σιν|eo|Skolo de la kvin elementoj|es|Wu Xing|et|Viie elemendi õpetus|fa|وو شینگ|fi|Viisi elementtiä|fr|Wuxing (cosmologie)|gan|五行|hak|Ńg-hàng|he|חמשת היסודות|hu|Öt elem (kínai)|hy|Ու Սին|id|Wu Xing|it|Wu Xing|ja|五行思想|ko|오행|lt|Using|mk|Пет елементи|ms|Wu Xing|nl|Wu Xing|no|De fem elementene|oc|Cinc elements (Wuxing)|pl|Wu xing|pt|Wu Xing|ro|Wu Xing|ru|У-син|simple|Five elements|sk|Učenie o piatich živloch|sl|Pet elementov (vušing)|sq|Wuxing (filozofia kineze)|sr|Пет космичких усмерења|sv|De fem elementen (wu xing)|tl|Limang elemento|tr|Beş element|uk|У-сін|vi|Ngũ hành|wuu|五行|za|Nguxhengz|zh|五行|zh_classical|陰陽五行|zh_min_nan|Ngó͘-hêng|zh_yue|五行|qid=Q218652|lt=Wuxing}}.

==Months of Yin Wood Ox==
The twelfth month (December) of Gregorian calendar years ending in 3 or 8 (Heavenly Stems 癸 or 戊) corresponds to Kinoto-Ushi months. However, this applies to the {{ill|Japanese Lunisolar Calendar|ja|旧暦}} or {{ill|Solar term|af|Sontermyn|ar|فصل شمسي|ast|Términos solares|cdo|Cáik-ké|cs|24 ťie-čchi|eo|Suna Periodo|es|Términos solares|fr|Période solaire|hak|Chiet-hì|he|תקופות חמה (לוח השנה הסיני)|id|Posisi matahari|ja|二十四節気|ko|절기|ms|Jieqi|ro|Termen solar|th|ภาวะ (ปฏิทินจีน)|tr|Güneş dönemi|vi|Tiết khí|wuu|節氣|za|Cietheiq|zh|节气|zh_classical|節氣|zh_min_nan|Cheh-khùi|zh_yue|節氣|qid=Q1190993|lt=Solar terms}} (from {{ill|Xiaohan|af|Xiaohan|cdo|Siēu-hàng|fr|Xiǎohán (période solaire)|hak|Séu-hòn|ja|小寒|ko|소한|sv|Xiaohan|vi|Tiểu hàn|za|Siujhanz|zh|小寒|zh_classical|小寒|zh_min_nan|Siáu-hân|zh_yue|小寒|qid=Q1190989|lt=Shōkan}} to the day before {{ill|Lichun|af|Lichun|bo|དཔྱིད་ཚུགས།|cdo|Lĭk-chŭng|es|Lichun|fr|Lichun|hak|Li̍p-chhûn|id|Lichun|ja|立春|ko|입춘|ms|Lichun|sv|Lichun|uz|Lichun|vi|Lập xuân|wuu|立春|za|Laebcin|zh|立春|zh_classical|立春|zh_min_nan|Li̍p-chhun|zh_yue|立春|qid=Q1364685|lt=Risshun}}) in traditional contexts.

==Days of Yin Wood Ox==
=== Rekichū ===
Days of Kinoto-Ushi are associated with the following annotations in the {{ill|Japanese calendar|ja|暦注下段}}:
* {{ill|Rekichū Gedan|ja|凶会日|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 暦注下段|comment=changed title based on wikidata|qid=Q11514957}} – applicable in the 3rd and 10th lunar months.
* {{ill|Rekichū Gedan|ja|五墓日|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 暦注下段|comment=changed title based on wikidata|qid=Q11514957}} – applies to individuals whose {{ill|natchin|ja|納音|comment=changed title based on wikidata|qid=Q10465180}} corresponds to the Wood element.
* {{ill|Rekichū Gedan|ja|神吉日|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 暦注下段|comment=changed title based on wikidata|qid=Q11514957}} – auspicious for spiritual matters.
